rv.q: "The Family Album", the moving and wonderfully entertaining world premiere musical at La Jolla Playhouse, reminds us that while every family's story is unique, family dysfunction is a language everyone speaks.
The Family Album is a creative, great new musical that is true to life and frequently moving.

With a book by Sam Chanse and story by Chanse, MILCK, and Jess McLeod , the piece has flow. Usually, new musicals aren't as sturdy , but because most of the songs had already been part of an album and marinated to create additional ones for the musical, the sound, rhythm, and vibe are solid and fitting.
